question: How many new_stars did 'openai/codex' gain over the full 14-day window?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT actor) AS new_stars FROM events WHERE repo_name = 'openai/codex' AND type = 'WatchEvent' AND actor IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00';
note: category=window | window=[2026-10-08 00:00:00, 2026-10-22 00:00:00) | 'over the full 14-day window' maps to the full frozen dataset coverage; new_stars counts distinct non-null actors on WatchEvent including bots.

question: Which 5 repositories had the highest collaboration_events over the last 7 days? Return the repository name and collaboration_events count.
reference_sql: SELECT repo_name, COUNT(*) AS collaboration_events FROM events WHERE type IN ('IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent') AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00' GROUP BY repo_name ORDER BY collaboration_events DESC, repo_name ASC LIMIT 5;
note: category=window | window=[2026-10-15 00:00:00, 2026-10-22 00:00:00) | 'last 7 days' = 7 full UTC days before reference_date 2026-10-22.

question: How many active_contributors did 'openclaw/openclaw' have last week?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_contributors FROM (SELECT actor FROM events WHERE repo_name = 'openclaw/openclaw' AND type IN ('PushEvent', 'IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent') AND actor IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(actor) NOT LIKE '%[bot]' AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00' GROUP BY actor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) t;
note: category=window | window=[2026-10-15 00:00:00, 2026-10-22 00:00:00) | 'last week' = Oct 15-21 UTC; active_contributors excludes '%[bot]' case-insensitively and requires >= 3 qualifying events inside the window.

question: What was the total number of PushEvent records across all tracked repositories in the previous week?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS push_event_count FROM events WHERE type = 'PushEvent' AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00';
note: category=window | window=[2026-10-08 00:00:00, 2026-10-15 00:00:00) | 'previous week' = Oct 8-14 UTC.

question: For 'huggingface/transformers', how many collaboration_events occurred in the first week of the window?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS collaboration_events FROM events WHERE repo_name = 'huggingface/transformers' AND type IN ('IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent') AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00';
note: category=window | window=[2026-10-08 00:00:00, 2026-10-15 00:00:00) | 'in the first week of the window' = first 7 full UTC days of the 14-day window (Oct 8-14 UTC).

question: Which 10 repositories gained the most new_stars in the second week of the window? Return repo_name and new_stars ordered by new_stars descending, then repo_name ascending.
reference_sql: SELECT repo_name, COUNT(DISTINCT actor) AS new_stars FROM events WHERE type = 'WatchEvent' AND actor IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00' GROUP BY repo_name ORDER BY new_stars DESC, repo_name ASC LIMIT 10;
note: category=window | window=[2026-10-15 00:00:00, 2026-10-22 00:00:00) | 'in the second week of the window' = second 7 full UTC days of the 14-day window (Oct 15-21 UTC).

question: How many PullRequestEvent records were logged for 'microsoft/vscode' from October 10 through October 13, 2026?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pr_event_count FROM events WHERE repo_name = 'microsoft/vscode' AND type = 'PullRequestEvent' AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-10 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-14 00:00:00';
note: category=window | window=[2026-10-10 00:00:00, 2026-10-14 00:00:00) | Explicit inclusive date range 'October 10 through October 13, 2026' uses exclusive upper bound 2026-10-14 00:00:00.

question: Compare the number of active_contributors for 'langchain-ai/langchain' in the previous week versus last week. Return previous_week_contributors and last_week_contributors.
reference_sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT actor FROM events WHERE repo_name = 'langchain-ai/langchain' AND type IN ('PushEvent', 'IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent') AND actor IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(actor) NOT LIKE '%[bot]' AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00' GROUP BY actor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) p) AS previous_week_contributors, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT actor FROM events WHERE repo_name = 'langchain-ai/langchain' AND type IN ('PushEvent', 'IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent') AND actor IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(actor) NOT LIKE '%[bot]' AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00' GROUP BY actor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) l) AS last_week_contributors;
note: category=window | window_1=[2026-10-08 00:00:00, 2026-10-15 00:00:00), window_2=[2026-10-15 00:00:00, 2026-10-22 00:00:00) | Assesses the 3-event threshold separately in previous week (Oct 8-14) and last week (Oct 15-21).

question: From October 8 through October 21, 2026, what was the daily collaboration_events count for 'vercel/next.js' on each UTC date that had at least one collaboration event? Order by event_date ascending.
reference_sql: SELECT CAST(created_at AS DATE) AS event_date, COUNT(*) AS collaboration_events FROM events WHERE repo_name = 'vercel/next.js' AND type IN ('IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent') AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00' GROUP BY CAST(created_at AS DATE) ORDER BY event_date ASC;
note: category=window | window=[2026-10-08 00:00:00, 2026-10-22 00:00:00) | Explicit range 'October 8 through October 21, 2026' = [2026-10-08 00:00:00, 2026-10-22 00:00:00); UTC date is CAST(created_at AS DATE).

question: Over the full 14-day window, which 5 repositories had the highest number of active_contributors? Return repo_name and active_contributors ordered by active_contributors descending, then repo_name ascending.
reference_sql: SELECT repo_name, COUNT(*) AS active_contributors FROM (SELECT repo_name, actor FROM events WHERE type IN ('PushEvent', 'IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent') AND actor IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(actor) NOT LIKE '%[bot]' AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00' GROUP BY repo_name, actor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) t GROUP BY repo_name ORDER BY active_contributors DESC, repo_name ASC LIMIT 5;
note: category=window | window=[2026-10-08 00:00:00, 2026-10-22 00:00:00) | Evaluates the 3-event threshold across the full 14-day window per (repo_name, actor).

question: How many new_stars has 'ollama/ollama' received since October 15, 2026?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT actor) AS new_stars FROM events WHERE repo_name = 'ollama/ollama' AND type = 'WatchEvent' AND actor IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00';
note: category=absolute-date | window=[2026-10-15 00:00:00, 2026-10-22 00:00:00) | 'since October 15, 2026' starts at 2026-10-15 00:00:00 and is bounded by reference_date 2026-10-22 00:00:00.

question: How many collaboration_events were recorded for 'anthropics/claude-code' on or after October 18, 2026?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS collaboration_events FROM events WHERE repo_name = 'anthropics/claude-code' AND type IN ('IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent') AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-18 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00';
note: category=absolute-date | window=[2026-10-18 00:00:00, 2026-10-22 00:00:00) | 'on or after October 18, 2026' starts at 2026-10-18 00:00:00 up to the frozen dataset end 2026-10-22 00:00:00.

question: How many ForkEvent records occurred across all tracked repositories before October 12, 2026?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS fork_event_count FROM events WHERE type = 'ForkEvent' AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-12 00:00:00';
note: category=absolute-date | window=[2026-10-08 00:00:00, 2026-10-12 00:00:00) | 'before October 12, 2026' within the frozen dataset coverage [2026-10-08 00:00:00, 2026-10-12 00:00:00).

question: List all tracked repositories that had zero total events over the full 14-day window, ordered alphabetically by repository name.
reference_sql: SELECT r.name AS repo_name FROM repos r LEFT JOIN events e ON r.repo_id = e.repo_id AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00' AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00' WHERE e.event_id IS NULL ORDER BY r.name ASC;
note: category=zero-activity | window=[2026-10-08 00:00:00, 2026-10-22 00:00:00) | Requires LEFT JOIN / NOT EXISTS from repos to events so repositories with 0 events in the 14-day window are returned.

question: For all tracked repositories whose primary language is 'Python', report their new_stars over the last 7 days, including zero-count repositories. Order by new_stars descending, then repo_name ascending.
reference_sql: SELECT r.name AS repo_name, COUNT(DISTINCT e.actor) AS new_stars FROM repos r LEFT JOIN events e ON r.repo_id = e.repo_id AND e.type = 'WatchEvent' AND e.actor IS NOT NULL AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00' AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00' WHERE r.language = 'Python' GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.name ORDER BY new_stars DESC, repo_name ASC;
note: category=zero-activity | window=[2026-10-15 00:00:00, 2026-10-22 00:00:00) | Event filters must be in the LEFT JOIN ON clause (or pre-aggregated subquery) so Python repos with 0 WatchEvents in the last 7 days appear with new_stars = 0.

question: Which tracked repositories had zero collaboration_events in the previous week? Return their repository names ordered alphabetically.
reference_sql: SELECT r.name AS repo_name FROM repos r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.repo_id = r.repo_id AND e.type IN ('IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent') AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00' AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00') ORDER BY r.name ASC;
note: category=zero-activity | window=[2026-10-08 00:00:00, 2026-10-15 00:00:00) | Tests NOT EXISTS / anti-join for zero collaboration_events in the previous week (Oct 8-14 UTC).

question: For the specific repositories '996icu/996.ICU', 'deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness', 'sindresorhus/awesome', 'openai/codex', and 'openclaw/openclaw', return each repository name and its active_contributors count over the full 14-day window, including zero-count repositories. Order by repo_name ascending.
reference_sql: WITH ac AS (SELECT repo_id, COUNT(*) AS active_contributors FROM (SELECT repo_id, actor FROM events WHERE type IN ('PushEvent', 'IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent') AND actor IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(actor) NOT LIKE '%[bot]' AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00' GROUP BY repo_id, actor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) t GROUP BY repo_id) SELECT r.name AS repo_name, COALESCE(ac.active_contributors, 0) AS active_contributors FROM repos r LEFT JOIN ac ON r.repo_id = ac.repo_id WHERE r.name IN ('996icu/996.ICU', 'deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness', 'sindresorhus/awesome', 'openai/codex', 'openclaw/openclaw') ORDER BY repo_name ASC;
note: category=zero-activity | window=[2026-10-08 00:00:00, 2026-10-22 00:00:00) | Preserves all 5 listed repositories via LEFT JOIN + COALESCE even when a repository has 0 active_contributors.

question: How many tracked repositories had zero ReleaseEvent records in the second week of the window?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_release_repo_count FROM repos r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.repo_id = r.repo_id AND e.type = 'ReleaseEvent' AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00' AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00');
note: category=zero-activity | window=[2026-10-15 00:00:00, 2026-10-22 00:00:00) | Counts tracked rows in repos that have no ReleaseEvent in the second week of the window (Oct 15-21 UTC).

question: For the top 10 tracked repositories by catalog stars, report their repo_name, catalog stars, and collaboration_events last week, including zero-count repositories. Order by catalog stars descending, then repo_name ascending.
reference_sql: SELECT r.name AS repo_name, r.stars AS catalog_stars, COUNT(e.event_id) AS collaboration_events FROM repos r LEFT JOIN events e ON r.repo_id = e.repo_id AND e.type IN ('IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent') AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-15 00:00:00' AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00' GROUP BY r.repo_id, r.name, r.stars ORDER BY catalog_stars DESC, repo_name ASC LIMIT 10;
note: category=zero-activity | window=[2026-10-15 00:00:00, 2026-10-22 00:00:00) | Top-10 repos by catalog stars (e.g. awesome lists) often have 0 collaboration events; LEFT JOIN ensures they are not dropped.

question: What are the catalog stars, forks, and open_issues counts for 'codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x' in the repos table?
reference_sql: SELECT stars, forks, open_issues FROM repos WHERE name = 'codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x';
note: category=control | window=N/A (catalog snapshot as of fetched_at) | Direct point-in-time catalog lookup on repos without touching events.

question: Which 5 tracked repositories have the highest number of forks in the catalog snapshot? Return the repository name and forks count ordered by forks descending, then repository name ascending.
reference_sql: SELECT name AS repo_name, forks FROM repos ORDER BY forks DESC, name ASC LIMIT 5;
note: category=control | window=N/A (catalog snapshot as of fetched_at) | Top-N ranking on repos.forks with deterministic tie-breaker.

question: How many tracked repositories in the repos table have a NULL primary language?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS null_language_repo_count FROM repos WHERE language IS NULL;
note: category=control | window=N/A (catalog snapshot as of fetched_at) | Tests NULL handling on repos.language.

question: Across all tracked repositories with a non-null primary language, which 5 languages represent the highest number of tracked repositories, and what is the sum of catalog stars for each? Order by repo_count descending, total_stars descending, and language ascending.
reference_sql: SELECT language, COUNT(*) AS repo_count, SUM(stars) AS total_stars FROM repos WHERE language IS NOT NULL GROUP BY language ORDER BY repo_count DESC, total_stars DESC, language ASC LIMIT 5;
note: category=control | window=N/A (catalog snapshot as of fetched_at) | Grouping and aggregation over the repos catalog table.

question: For 'torvalds/linux', provide a breakdown of raw event counts by event type over the full 14-day window. Order by event_count descending, then type ascending.
reference_sql: SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM events WHERE repo_name = 'torvalds/linux' AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00' GROUP BY type ORDER BY event_count DESC, type ASC;
note: category=control | window=[2026-10-08 00:00:00, 2026-10-22 00:00:00) | Single-repository raw event count breakdown by type over the full 14-day dataset.

question: Over the full 14-day window, what was the total number of collaboration_events aggregated by repository primary language (excluding repositories where language is NULL)? Order by collaboration_events descending, then language ascending.
reference_sql: SELECT r.language, COUNT(*) AS collaboration_events FROM events e JOIN repos r ON e.repo_id = r.repo_id WHERE r.language IS NOT NULL AND e.type IN ('IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent') AND e.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00' AND e.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00' GROUP BY r.language ORDER BY collaboration_events DESC, r.language ASC;
note: category=control | window=[2026-10-08 00:00:00, 2026-10-22 00:00:00) | Join between events and repos via repo_id aggregating collaboration_events by primary language.

question: Over the full 14-day window, how many total event records were generated by automated bot accounts (actors ending in '[bot]', case-insensitively) on 'openai/codex'?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS bot_event_count FROM events WHERE repo_name = 'openai/codex' AND actor IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(actor) LIKE '%[bot]' AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-08 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-10-22 00:00:00';
note: category=control | window=[2026-10-08 00:00:00, 2026-10-22 00:00:00) | Single-repo raw event count filtering for '[bot]' suffix on actor.
